sourceText:
BLT Alphabet Soup
By: Sheri Wetherell
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




4 ounces Alphabet pasta, uncooked
29 ounces Each whole tomatoes, undrained
14 ounces Ready-to-serve beef broth
1 cup Water
Salt/pepper
1 pound Bacon, cooked and crumbled
Chopped iceberg lettuce
Toasted croutons optional
Mayonnaise optional

Preparation

1 In medium saucepan; stir together pasta; tomatoes with juice; broth and water; heat to boiling. Boil; stirring frequently to break up tomatoes; 5 minutes or until pasta is done. Salt and pepper to taste. In each bowl; place 1/3 c lettuce; ladle 1 c soup over top. Sprinkle with 1/4 c crumbled bacon; top with croutons and mayonnaise; if desired. 6 servings. 2 Prep Time: 20 min. 3 Start to Finish: 20 min.
